description: This source file defines the SlugifyParameterTransformer class which implements the IOutboundParameterTransformer interface. Its purpose is to transform parameter values into URL-friendly 'slugs' by converting camelCase or PascalCase strings into kebab-case using a regex replacement.

classes.name: SlugifyParameterTransformer
classes.description: A class that transforms route parameters into URL slugs for outbound URL generation.

methods.name: TransformOutbound
methods.description: Transforms an input object into a URL-friendly string by applying a regex that converts camelCase or PascalCase to kebab-case.
